title: Riding the L-1011 jump seat posing as FAA
summary: Bob Lazar tells of Riding the L-1011 jump seat posing as FAA, about 1980s at Las Vegas, Nevada, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: he'd tell the co-pilot and engineer, "Hey, this guy's from the FAA, so he's just going to be observing us and taking it."

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he once worked on alien craft for the US government, told podcast host Jesse Michels that in the 1980s he flew from Las Vegas to Minneapolis in the cockpit jump seat, a spare seat behind the pilots, of an L-1011 passenger jet. He says his friend John Lear told the co-pilot and flight engineer that Lazar was from the FAA, the US agency that oversees air safety, and was just there to observe.
